Hero.fullName: DOHOU GBENOUPKO FAWASE — AKA OMO IYA ONIRICE
Hero.description: Software engineer and product builder for startups and companies. I turn complex problems into fast, scalable, AI-powered applications that convert your visitors into customers. From design to frontend, all the way to backend: the goal isn't just to write code, but to measure your success.

About.headlineLine1: Products that start with a question
About.bioP1: My name is DOHOU GBENOUPKO FAWASE, known online as <name>OMO IYA ONIRICE</name>. I solve business problems through code. I sit at the intersection of product, design, and engineering: the kind of profile that can wireframe a flow in the morning and ship the API by evening.
About.bioP2: Over 4+ years, I've designed brands and shipped 8+ web and mobile products for startups in real estate, fintech, and SaaS. I don't just make things look good; I build products that attract users, retain them, and turn attention into revenue.
About.bioP3: If you're looking for someone who can own the full product lifecycle, from visual identity to technical architecture, all while keeping an eye on your bottom line, let's talk.

design.title: Product Design
design.desc: From wireframes to polished, high-converting interfaces designed to turn your visitors into paying customers.

dev.title: Web & Mobile Development
dev.desc: Fast, accessible front-ends paired with robust back-ends in React, Next.js, Laravel, Nest.js, and MySQL, built to sell and to scale.

branding.title: Branding & Identity
branding.desc: Visual systems that make your product feel trustworthy and premium, so your customers buy with confidence.

architecture.title: Scalable Architecture

Principles.headlinePrefix: The ideas that guide my work

feel.title: Feel is a feature.
feel.desc: Latency, motion, fluidity, and rhythm are all part of the product. If an interface feels unpleasant or poorly tuned, it's broken, no matter what the spec says.

ship.title: Ship small, ship often.
ship.desc: The best version of a feature is the one in production today, learning from real users. I'd rather make one careful tweak a week than one ten-page rewrite.

document.title: Write it down.
document.desc: Code is a form of expression. So are docs, commit messages, and shared write-ups. Clear writing compounds in value and guides the next developer (often, future me).

stack.title: Proven tech, sharp taste.
stack.desc: I default to Laravel, Next.js, TypeScript, and a small set of trusted tools. I reinvest all the technical complexity that saves directly back into the product experience.
